limits: Windows x64 / Node v25.0.0 only; Linux/macOS not executed.
The lock is an in-machine mutex: separate machines sharing one state root over a network filesystem are out of scope.
Multi-process contention is a real-process regression test, not a deterministic barrier; the deterministic lock-discipline case is the holder test.
